bullets.text: Starlink Spectrum Boost - **Ofcom** grants **Starlink** more spectrum to enhance backhaul capacity in the UK.
5G Core Transformation - **5G** networks are evolving into programmable, intelligent systems, reshaping connectivity.
AI-Driven Telecoms Growth - **Telecom operators** are rapidly adopting **AI** to enhance cloud infrastructure and automate operations.
Energy Efficiency in 5G - New research highlights the urgent need for energy-saving strategies in **5G** networks.
MTN's StarEdge Horizon - **MTN** launches a Layer 2 solution for enhanced **LEO** satellite connectivity.
Agentic AI in Telecoms - **Telcos** are poised to lead the **AI** economy with autonomous, context-aware systems.
Nokia's Strong Q3 - **Nokia** reports better-than-expected profits, driven by demand in **AI** and cloud services.
Lynk and Omnispace Merger - **Lynk** and **Omnispace** merge to enhance global satellite direct-to-device connectivity.
5G Energy Consumption - By 2030, **5G** networks could consume 5% of global electricity, necessitating innovative solutions.
Amigo Mesh Network - New mesh network project aims to keep political protesters connected during internet blackouts.
